comment.narrative: 2023 3453982702Rwf allocated to the DPK joint youth programs. A score of 50 suggests that while Rwanda is providing some information necessary for informed public debate about budgetary decisions it falls short of the threshold of 61 which is considered adequate for supporting meaningful public engagement in budget discussions. The increase from a previous score of 45 in 2021 indicates a slight improvement in transparency positioning Rwanda at 59th out of 125 countries assessed in this survey.
